name: CubeSandbox
description: Tencent Cloud's open-source microVM agent sandbox, E2B-SDK compatible.
descriptionZh: 腾讯云开源的 microVM Agent 沙箱，兼容 E2B SDK。
keyFact: CubeSandbox, open-sourced by Tencent Cloud on 21 April 2026 under Apache-2.0, runs each agent in a KVM-isolated microVM built on RustVMM: it reports a best-case cold start under 60ms (about 67ms average) and under 5MB memory overhead per sandbox, and is API-compatible with the E2B SDK.
keyFactZh: CubeSandbox 由腾讯云于 2026 年 4 月 21 日以 Apache-2.0 开源，基于 RustVMM + KVM 为每个 Agent 提供独立内核的 microVM 隔离：官方给出的最优冷启动低于 60ms（均值约 67ms）、每个沙箱内存开销低于 5MB，并兼容 E2B SDK 接口。
caveat: The <60ms figure is a best case at low concurrency; P95 is ~90ms and P99 ~137ms under 50 concurrent creates on bare metal per the project.
caveatZh: <60ms 为低并发下的最优值；据项目方数据，裸金属上 50 并发创建时 P95 约 90ms、P99 约 137ms。
